questions.q: Completa: I'm sitting on the ___ and I'm writing this text.

task: Mira por la ventana o imagina un lugar. Escribe 5 frases con el presente continuo: qué está haciendo la gente.
paragraphs: It's Sunday afternoon and the sun is shining. A lot of people are in Green Park today.
Near the lake, two children are feeding the ducks. Their mother is sitting on a bench and she is reading a book. A man in a red T-shirt is running with his dog.
Under a big tree, a group of friends are having a picnic. They are eating sandwiches and drinking lemonade. One girl is playing the guitar and the others are singing.
An old man is selling ice cream. Many people are buying one, because it's very hot. I'm sitting on the grass and I'm writing this text. I love Sundays!
